objective: Remove private release-drill environments and make release drills select project-owned architecture environments.
users: Project members creating and maintaining release drill rounds.

requirements.statement: Remove the private release-drill environment capability.
acceptance: Menu, route, UI, API, permission, model and table are removed.
counterexample: The old environment route remains accessible.

requirements.statement: Use active project architecture environments for release-drill selection.
acceptance: The service rejects cross-project, missing or inactive environments.
counterexample: The release module reads arch_environment directly.

requirements.statement: Destructively remove legacy private environment data and dependent drill data.
acceptance: V217 deletes legacy environments, rounds, steps and related issues before dropping the table.
counterexample: Legacy drill records remain with dangling environment IDs.

requirements.statement: Prevent deletion of an architecture environment referenced by a release drill.
acceptance: Deletion fails with a conflict when an active drill round references the environment.
counterexample: Deleting the environment leaves a dangling drill reference.

requirements.statement: Preserve cross-module ownership and server-side authorization boundaries.
acceptance: Release consumes architecture environments only through the public integration contract while existing tenant, project-member, RBAC, optimistic-lock and audit checks remain enforced.
requirements.source: Project governance and approved requirement constraints
counterexample: Release queries architecture tables or private services directly.

invariants: Release consumes architecture only through public interfaces.
Tenant, project, RBAC, optimistic-lock and audit checks remain server-side.
No historical Flyway script is modified.
constraints: Only REQ-084 writable paths may change.
Legacy data deletion is irreversible by application rollback.
No production access or secret reads.

selected_approach.name: Destructive replacement with architecture environment references
selected_approach.reason: The user explicitly chose data clearing with no compatibility support.

alternatives.name: Name-based migration
alternatives.rejected_because: It is ambiguous and retains redundant data.

components.name: ReleaseOperationsService
components.responsibility: Validate and persist architecture environment references

interfaces.name: Architecture environment projection
interfaces.contract: Active project environment id, code, name and type.

transitions: release service resolves it through the public directory
architecture validates tenant, project and ACTIVE status
data_flows.output: drill round with architecture environment projection

error_handling.behavior: Disable new drill creation with explicit warning
error_handling.recovery: Maintain an environment in architecture management.
Refresh and choose an active environment.
Remove or reassign the drill first.

compatibility: No legacy environment endpoint or data compatibility by user decision
operations: Pre-migration backup required due to irreversible cleanup

verification_strategy.signal: Menu/API removal and validated architecture references
verification_strategy.method: Focused release and architecture tests plus browser flow.

verification_strategy.signal: Legacy data and table absent after V217

assumptions.text: Architecture environments are project-owned and active-state validated by the existing service.
assumptions.falsifier: The public query cannot distinguish project or active state.

decisions.decision: Delete legacy environment and dependent drill data without migration.
Reuse architecture through a public read contract.

risks.impact: Legacy drill records cannot be restored by rollback
risks.mitigation: Require backup and migration integration evidence before release.

approval.evidence: User confirmed the design and stated that prior data should be cleared without compatibility.
